title: Priority Stabilizer for Key Account Intake and Escalation Triage
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Problem: Strategic (top) accounts escalate feature asks and support blockers into the roadmap with inconsistent signals: duplicate requests, unclear business impact, and ad-hoc SLA expectations. This creates churn in quarterly planning and frequent rework for Eng/Product.

Goal: Ship a lightweight, repeatable 'Priority Stabilizer' that normalizes inbound signals for top accounts and produces a deterministic intake decision and recommended runway (fastpass, scoped sprint, or advisory). The stabilizer combines: weighted business signals, support heat, renewal risk, implementation complexity estimate, and cross-functional readiness. It must surface an operational SLO for intake decisions and a developer-facing artifact that Engineering can action (spec template + rollout lane).

Scope: MVP covers top-50 accounts and all escalations that route through CSM/Support. Includes:
- Normalization algorithm and threshold rules for Fastpass (immediate canary slot), Scoped Sprint (next quarter allocation), and Advisory (product consulting + backlog grooming).
- Intake form changes (CSM/Support UI) and automated enrichment (billing tier, ARR, last renewal date, open incidents).
- Dashboard in Console that shows intake queue, confidence score, and recommended route.
- Exportable artifact (PRD link + acceptance criteria) that Eng uses to scope work.

Out of scope for MVP: automated contract negotiation, pricing adjustments, and fully automated deployment gating (will be follow-up).

Success metrics (target by EOW 2026-Q2):
- 80% of escalations get a deterministic route recommendation within 48 hours.
- Reduce time-to-first-response for top-account escalations from median 5 days -> 1 day.
- Reduce ad-hoc roadmap churn attributed to untriaged top-account asks by 30% vs baseline.

Key stakeholders: PM (Avery Chen), Eng lead (Rory Patel), Solutions Eng (Maya Singh), CSM Ops (Jonas Meyer), Support Escalations (Priya Rao), Legal (for later contractual work).

acceptance_criteria: Intake form enrichment adds ARR, billing tier, open incident count, and last renewal date to every top-account escalation before scoring.
Automated scoring function outputs a confidence score and recommended route (Fastpass | Scoped Sprint | Advisory) for >=80% of inputs within 48 hours.
Console queue shows sorted list of escalations with score, recommended route, and three quick actions. UX flows validated by design and PM.
Every finalized intake decision writes an audit log entry with contributor, timestamp, and linked PRD or note.
Eng accepts the generated artifact (spec template + estimated story points) and is able to schedule Fastpass slots for at least 2 items in the first sprint.
Basic telemetry: intake latency, recommendation coverage, manual overrides rate, and downstream reassignments are emitted to the observability pipeline.
